Definition: from G846 and G5495; self-handed, i.e. doing personally:--with … own hands.
BiblicalUsage: On the third day of the storm the sailors cast out the tackling of the ship with their own hands, and the word means with one's own hands, doing it personally. It appears only here.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the sailors' own hands could not save the ship, and the lightening of it only proved how little was left in their control.
